newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-UKRAINE WASTE CHANCES IN 1-0 WIN OVER ALBANIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UKRAINE WASTE CHANCES IN 1-0 WIN OVER ALBANIA.

text.p: Ukraine wasted a hatful of chances on their way to a comfortable 1-0 win over Albania in their World Cup European group nine qualifier on Saturday.
Serguei Rebrov put his side ahead just before half-time, but the Ukranian forward line were otherwise denied by goalkeeper Foto Strakosha.
Strakosha made half a dozen fine saves, including several from Rebrov, who did well to keep his head in scoring but had a poor game overall.

Albania had fewer opportunities to score, but had a goal disallowed for offside in the first-half and threw away a golden opportunity to equalise twelve minutes from time when substitute Alban Bujhaj miscued a header from a corner.
The result put Ukraine level on points with top-of-the-table Portugal, but their goal difference remains slightly inferior. The game was switched to Spain because of the current turmoil in Albania.
